input.summary: Make the Article 23 source code licence transferable to Customer's successor in a merger or acquisition.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that the licence must transfer to a successor in a merger or acquisition, so we made the Section 23.4 grant transferable to Customer's successor and carved that successor out of the Section 23.5 third-party transfer restriction. Affiliates already fall within the defined "Customer", so no further affiliate wording is needed.

ops.oldText: M&I hereby grants to Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable license, through the end of the Term,
ops.newText: M&I hereby grants to Customer a non-exclusive license, transferable to Customer's successor by merger or acquisition, through the end of the Term,

ops.oldText: but shall not (1) distribute, sell, transfer, assign or sublicense the source code or any parts thereof to any third party
ops.newText: but shall not (1) distribute, sell, transfer, assign or sublicense the source code or any parts thereof to any third party other than Customer's successor by merger or acquisition
